description: This file defines a custom PHPUnit comparator for PHP Enums, enabling better assertion messages when comparing Enum instances within tests.

classes.name: Comparator
classes.description: Custom PHPUnit comparator for MyCLabs Enum to improve assertion output.

methods.name: accepts
methods.description: Determines if the comparator can handle the provided expected and actual values, specifically for Enum instances or null.

methods.name: assertEquals
methods.description: Asserts that two Enum values are equal, throwing a ComparisonFailure with formatted output if not.

methods.name: formatEnum
methods.description: Formats an Enum instance into a string showing its class and key, or returns 'null' if the Enum is null.
